thread:
jess: Noticing a weird cluster of negative balances in the reseller portal this morning for GCP marketplace partners. Numbers look like credits, but partner statements show double-prorated amounts. Anyone else seeing this?

ian: Yep. Pager picked up multiple credit events from the marketplace webhook consumer between 03:10-03:20 UTC. Suspect the proration handler retried and applied a second credit.

priya: Example partner record (sanitized):
```
partner: devworks | original_charge: 1340.00 | prorate_credit: -210.00 | portal_balance: -210.00 -> then additional credit -210.00 -> balance -420.00
```
That extra -210 shouldn't be there.

marc: Oof. That explains partner support tickets. How many partners affected?

ian: Quick query across `invoice_events` shows 42 distinct partner_ids, total credits ~= $12,400 USD. I can export CSV with invoice_id, partner_id, event_id, webhook_id.

jess: Please do. Pause any auto-credit automation for marketplace feeds until we confirm idempotency fixes. Also flag any credits > $2000 for manual review.

billing-bot: Automated note: marketplace-webhook-consumer reported 67 processed events; 24 replayed due to transient 5xx from billing-service. job: replay-1990055555.

priya: Looks like the replay logic doesn't dedupe on `webhook_id` in the credit path. Engineering, can we fast-track a hotfix? We need dedupe by webhook_id and idempotency-key.

ian: I'll open a PR to check `webhook_id` and short-circuit duplicate credits. Also scheduling a recompute job for affected invoice range (invoices created 2026-03-29 03:00:00 - 2026-03-29 03:30:00). Need finance sign-off to apply reversals/recomputes.

jess: Finance approves recompute and reversal for the impacted window. Keep manual hold on collections for those partners until after comms.

marc: Partner Success - start a light-touch comms draft. Prioritize partners with balances < -$500 and partners with enterprise contacts. We'll offer corrected statement and offer a handoff for any billing questions.

priya: Adding remediation checklist: 1) Pause credits for marketplace channel. 2) Deploy dedupe hotfix. 3) Run invoice recompute for affected invoices. 4) Produce partner CSV and comms. 5) Reconcile ledger and post audit entries.

ian: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood/finance/gcp-prorate-duplicates-1990055555.csv (cols: invoice_id, partner_id, webhook_id, credit_amount_usd, contact_email).

billing-bot: Job update: recompute queued by ian; estimate 22m. job-id: rc_1990055555_01

jess: Legal - loop in only if partner asks for contract-level remediation. For now, Partner Success handles the outreach. Also approve one-off manual credits to correct ledger where recompute won't retroactively adjust payment gateway refunds (cap $5k per partner).

marc: Noted. I'll triage partners and start comms for the top 10 by credit size.

jess: Keep this thread for status updates. Please post when hotfix deployed and when recompute finishes. Thanks.
notes: Root cause: marketplace webhook consumer replay/dedup bug causing proration credits to be applied twice for GCP marketplace subscriptions. Impact: 42 partners, ~$12.4k total credits. Actions: pause auto-credits, deploy dedupe hotfix, run invoice recompute for affected window, prepare partner comms, finance approved recompute and limited manual correction caps.
